description: physics.derailment new: an EU07 with three coaches and no driver runs at 133 km/h into the curve tdo_n222 of td.scn (R 600 m, cant 65 mm), buckled hard 600 mm over a main lobe of 8 m from the start (the buckle keyword of the track). The locomotive overturns on the buckle: it leaves the track, falls on its side within a second and slides on the ground to a stop some 170 m on, 30 m off the track; the coaches behind it go off and over as well, and the train comes to rest folded, the vehicles turned against each other by 10 to 20 degrees.
